body.name: Finite-sample whole-set band
body.construction: Represent every \(f\in\mathfrak F^-_T\cup\mathfrak F^+_T\) by its armwise coefficient functions, compute \(\varepsilon_f\), form \(\mathcal C_{\rm end}\), and report \(\mathcal C_{\rm set}\); if \(N_0N_1=0\), report the trivial endpoint box and \([-1,1]\).
